common.offline: You're offline. We'll retry when you're back.
common.somethingWentWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.noConnection: No internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unreachable: We can't reach the college right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.timeout: That took too long. Please try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to that.
errors.invalid: Please check the details and try again.
errors.conflict: That didn't go through. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.moduleDisabled: Admissions are closed right now. Please check back later.
errors.server: The college's server had a problem. Please try again.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.presetHint: Pick the palette you like. The college can change the default at any time.
appearance.presetLocked: Your college has chosen the theme for everyone.

auth.welcomeBody: Apply to {name}, track your application and stay in touch with admissions.
auth.signInWithCode: Email me a sign-in code instead
auth.termsNote: By continuing you agree to the admissions terms of {name}.
auth.signedOutServer: You were signed out because your session ended.
auth.signedOutOffline: We couldn't reach the college to restore your session.
auth.verifyBody: We sent a 6-character code to {email}. Enter it below.
auth.verifyCodeInvalid: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
auth.codeSent: A new code is on its way.
auth.mfaBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.loginCodeBody: We'll email you a one-time code so you don't need your password.
auth.loginCodeConfirmBody: Type the code we emailed to {email}.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.forgotSentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.
auth.resetBody: Pick something you'll remember. You'll sign in again afterwards.
auth.resetDoneBody: Sign in with your new password.
auth.resetInvalidKey: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
auth.choiceBody: We don't have an account for {email} yet. Would you like to apply for admission to {college}?
auth.noPortalBody: Your account doesn't have a mobile portal. Please use the web portal or contact the admissions office.
auth.appleFailed: Sign in with Apple didn't complete.

profile.title: Profile
profile.signOutConfirmBody: You'll need your email and password to sign back in.
profile.offlineSnapshot: Showing your last known details. We'll refresh when you're back online.

applications.title: Your applications
applications.emptyBody: Start your application and we'll guide you through every step.
applications.copyFamilyBody: Save time by copying parents, address and emergency contact from an earlier application.
applications.deleteDraftBody: Everything you've typed in it will be gone.
applications.withdrawBody: The office will be told. You can start a new application later.
applications.closedBody: Applications are not being accepted right now. Please check back later.
applications.sentBody: Thank you. We'll be in touch about your documents and interview.
applications.trackerSoon: Tracking arrives in the next update. Watch your email for now.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Updates about your application will appear here.

lede.family: Who you are, where you live, and who we should contact.
lede.studies: Where you study now, how it's going, and what you'd like to take here.
lede.review: Write a few lines, add what you have now, check your details, and send. Anything marked "later" won't hold you up.

form.offlineSaved: Saved on this phone. We'll send it when you're back online.
form.fixMarked: A few things still need you. They're marked in red.
form.resumeBody: You made changes on this phone that never reached the college. Continue with them, or go back to the saved copy.
form.leftToast: Saved. Pick up where you left off any time from your applications.

about.title: About you
about.dualSub: Only if you're a citizen of another country as well as Pakistan.
about.photoHint: Passport-style. A phone photo against a plain wall works.
about.bformHint: A photo of the front is enough.

parents.title: Parents
parents.note: One parent is enough to apply. Add the other now or later.

emergency.title: Emergency contact
emergency.note: Who we call if we can't reach you during the day.

siblings.toggle: A brother or sister studies or studied at {name}
siblings.sub: Optional. It helps us link your family's records.
siblings.name: Name

school.title: Current school
school.name: School name
school.campusHint: e.g. Gulshan Campus, or the address
school.private: I'm a private candidate, not at a school

grades.title: Your grades
grades.note: Two lists: papers whose results are out, then papers still to sit or whose results aren't out yet. A subject goes in one list only.
grades.outNote: Papers you've already sat whose results are out: pick the grade you got.
grades.outEmpty: No results yet. Tap a subject below to add one.
grades.awaitedTitle: Still to sit, or results not out yet
grades.awaitedNote: Papers you haven't sat yet, or whose results aren't out: add the sitting and, if you have one, your expected grade.
grades.awaitedEmpty: Nothing here yet. Add the subjects you're still waiting on.
grades.customHint: Type the subject, e.g. Marine Science
grades.resultPredicted: Not out yet? Leave this, or attach a statement if you have one. We'll remind you when results are announced.
grades.resultAttachHint: Attach your results as combined statements (you can add more than one, for different sittings) or one file per subject — whichever you have. You can add more at any time.
grades.midTermHint: Helps if your results aren't out yet.

subjects.title: A-Level subjects you'd like
subjects.note: Pick 3 to 5. You can change them after your counselling session.
subjects.noneOpen: No subjects are open for this level yet.
subjects.teacherNote: Where a subject has more than one teacher, pick the one you'd prefer. We'll place you with them if their class has a seat. You can switch later in the add/drop window.
subjects.futureHint: Helps our counsellors check your subjects fit the university route you want.
subjects.futurePlaceholder: Choose or type, e.g. Medicine, Computer Science, Law

referee.title: Referee
referee.note: A teacher who can recommend you. We'll only contact them if we need to.
referee.toggle: I'd like to add a referee
referee.sub: Optional. Leave it off if you don't have one.
referee.name: Their name
referee.letterHint: If your referee has already written one. Otherwise we'll ask them.

beyond.title: Beyond the classroom
beyond.note: Tap anything you do, add a line about it, and attach a certificate or letter if you have one.
beyond.otherSport: Name the sport, e.g. Horse riding
beyond.otherActivity: What else have you done? e.g. Hifz, Volunteer tutoring
beyond.activityDetailsHint: What did you do? e.g. Beach clean-up, 3 drives
beyond.addedByYou: Added by you. Tap to remove.
beyond.alreadyListed: {name} is already on the list, so we selected it.
beyond.added: {name} added. Add a line about it below.
beyond.trialSub: For a sports scholarship. You'll book a trial after you apply.
beyond.moreSub: Special circumstances, extra qualifications, or anything the form doesn't cover.

statement.title: Your statement
statement.note: Why {name}, and what you want from your A-Levels. Your interviewer reads this first.
statement.prompt1: I want to study at {name} because…
statement.prompt2: The subject I enjoy most is…

documentsBlock.title: Documents
documentsBlock.needed: {n} marked "Before interview" are needed before your interview. Everything else can follow.
documentsBlock.neededOne: One, marked "Before interview", is needed before your interview. Everything else can follow.
documentsBlock.none: You can book your interview without these. Add them when you can.

declaration.text: I confirm the details are correct. I understand {name} may ask for original documents at enrolment, and that expected grades will be checked against final results.

req.first_name: Add your first name as on your B-Form.
req.cnic: Enter the 13-digit number from your B-Form or CNIC.
req.mobile: Add a mobile number we can reach you on.
req.guardians: Add at least one parent or guardian.
req.emg_relation: How are they related to you?
req.school: Tell us which school you're at.
req.school_campus: Add the campus name or address.
req.results: Add the subjects you've sat or are sitting. Each result that's out needs its grade.
req.parent_mobile: We need a number to call about your interview.

format.phone: Enter a mobile number (not a landline) for the chosen country. For Pakistan: 0300 1234567.
format.email: That doesn't look like an email address. Check for a typo, like name@example.com.
format.cnic: A CNIC or B-Form number has 13 digits, like 42101-1234567-8.

errors.teacherGeneric: Pick a teacher for this subject.
errors.statementShort: Write at least 80 words. A few honest lines are better than a polished essay.
errors.statementLong: That's over 300 words. Trim it to the parts that matter most.

documents.replaceSub: The office asked for a clearer copy. Please upload it again.
documents.anotherOverallSub: For subjects from a later sitting. Each statement is kept.
documents.earlierOne: 1 earlier copy kept on your record
documents.earlierMany: {n} earlier copies kept on your record
documents.resultSubPredicted: Upload it when results are announced.
documents.resultSubNow: You can add it now or later.
documents.resultAwaiting: Awaiting result. Add it when it's announced, or send another combined statement.
